interpretation: This policy records reviewed local checks and explicit deferrals; it is not a claim that CI, Aqua, JET, or documentation hosting has run.

checks.scope: local package regression suite in the benchmark environment
API tiers, benchmark helper accounting, and JSON schema inventory
read-only consistency checks and release-gate shape

checks.reason: No reviewed documentation build environment is configured in the local benchmark project.
Aqua is not a declared package dependency and is intentionally not installed by the local baseline.
JET is not a declared package dependency and extension-specific targets require a reviewed environment.
